books.description:
Park Heeju lost her dream of ballet in school thanks to a trap set by Kim Taei. Joining forces with Jinny, a star who was also a victim of school bullying, she begins her revenge. Becoming the 24-hour life manager of Taei’s husband, Kang Junho, Heeju wins his heart and shakes up Taei’s life. Taei fights back by kidnapping Heeju, but her affair with Junho’s older brother Kang Junhee, her pregnancy, her school bullying, and her abuse of power are all exposed, and she loses everything.
But Taei, who never shows remorse, is sentenced to prison for kidnapping and attempted murder and is locked in a psychiatric hospital. Junho, who dreamed of a love with Heeju, also becomes a target of the revenge and is arrested over the corruption Heeju exposed. With her revenge complete, Jinny confesses her own wounds to the world, and Heeju begins a new life teaching ballet to children.
books.title: 24 Hours with Your Husband

books.description: After her fiancé forces wolfsbane down her throat and her own family hands her over, Sienna wakes as a substitute bride to Garrick Thorne—a blind Alpha cursed to die at the next Full Moon Rite. He tries to strangle her, until her blood touches his curse marks and they recede: she is a Moonblood, heir to the mother her father erased. They strike a bargain—her blood for his power, his for revenge.
books.title: The Substitute Bride of the Cursed Alpha

books.description: Ryan has been drawn to Victoria, his wife Claire’s 46-year-old mother, since the day they met. When a problem with the lease on their new home forces Ryan and Claire to stay with Claire’s parents, Claire leaves on a three-week business trip. Victoria comes to Ryan’s room and sets the rules for their affair. She teaches Ryan how to lead her, and their affair continues after Claire returns.
books.title: While My Wife's Away

books.description: Betrayed by her husband Victor, who married her only to steal her dragon blood, Aria narrowly escapes a deadly ritual. Hunted and left for dead, she is rescued by Kael, a mysterious knight with dragon blood flowing through his veins. As a dangerous attraction grows between them, they discover that their powers are mysteriously connected. But Victor refuses to let Aria escape, and the dark secrets of Kael's past threaten their growing love.
books.title: Taken by the Dragon-Blooded Knight

books.description: Seven years ago Celeste, the town's nun, damned Taylor Walker for an orgy he was drugged into and had him banished. He returns for the inheritance and decides his revenge will be to corrupt her. Pinning her to the wall, dragging her rosary down his chest, opening her habit one button at a time, he steeps her in his own hunger until it becomes hers. Revenge leaves them starving for each other.
books.title: How to Break Her Virtuous Vows

books.description: Luther Cross was a captain until the Empire took his name and the woman he swore to protect. Five years later her daughter, Mara Vale, finds him drunk in a tavern, with a map to an erased island tattooed across her back and a blade in hand. Luther must reclaim his crew, his ship, and his name and become the pirate king the Empire invented.
books.title: Rise Of The Pirate King

books.description: Three years ago, Charlotte entered a contract marriage with Damian, a chaebol heir she's never even seen, to pay for her twin brother Charlie's surgery. Now, as their contract nears its end, Charlotte disguises herself as a man to take Charlie's place as a secretary at Cross Group—only to end up serving the notoriously cold CEO, Damian himself. As she hides her identity by his side, Damian finds himself inexplicably drawn to his "male" secretary. Neither knows who the other truly is, and as they grow closer, a scheming rival plots to tear them apart…
books.title: Sir, I'm actually Your Wife

books.description: Raised and abandoned in the countryside, Yoon Ari is sold in her half-sister’s place to the heir of Hanmyeong Group — rumored to be a wife-beating eunuch. She escapes on her wedding day and hides in a sedan, only to find it belongs to the groom himself, Han Taejin. Not recognizing him, she vents freely about what a monster the heir is. Taejin, urgently needing to fulfill his grandfather’s marriage order, offers to help her — in exchange for her hand. He disguises himself as her driver and takes her to his grandparents’ home in the countryside. There, for the first time, Ari feels the warmth of family, nestled beside the old couple and her seemingly indifferent yet quietly tender “driver husband.” But when her family comes to drag her back, they sneer that she married a country bumpkin — and turn violent against the elderly couple. Then Taejin steps forward. When the driver they dismissed is revealed as the heir to Hanmyeong Group, a deeply satisfying counterattack begins.
books.title: Married the Driver, Got a Billionaire

books.description:
To pay off her debt, Emily enters tycoon K's Velvet Room. Suffering from touch aversion, K offers an absolute obedience contract to the only woman he can touch.

As Emily falls into his irresistible control, she pursues her Hollywood dream while both become each other's sole salvation amidst scandals and intrigue.
books.title: The Velvet Prison

books.description: After her fiancé Leo falls into a river and is presumed dead, a devastated Willa crosses a forbidden line one stormy night with Magnus—Leo’s father and an underworld godfather. Bound by revenge, their alliance turns to love. Then Leo returns alive, pulling all three into a tangle of desire and loyalty. After a war with the Blood Axe Gang, they choose each other—as a hidden camera watches.
books.title: His Father, My Daddy

books.description: Struggling with a fear of intimacy, Leah is given an AI robot modeled after her idol, rock superstar Aiden—never guessing the robot is Aiden himself in disguise. At a party she falls into a pool and panics, certain the machine will short-circuit and the accident turn deadly. But Aiden dives in and kisses her underwater, and instead of mechanical chill she feels warmth and a racing heart.
books.title: Custom Lover

books.description: Astrid loved the storm god Magni for ten years and saved his life, but he believed Selma did and kept Astrid as her shield. So Astrid swaps grooms with Selma. Then Magni sides with Selma and strikes Astrid with lightning, killing the baby he never knew she carried. She weds the Beast King, who treats her like a queen. Too late, Magni learns the truth and kneels to beg. Astrid never looks back.
books.title: The Beast I Chose Over the God

books.description: Art student Olivia has a crush on hockey star Liam. When she accidentally learns the campus playboy is secretly an anonymous adult-content creator, the two strike a risky fake-dating deal to protect his identity. Fighting campus bullying and a growing conspiracy side by side, their pretend romance starts to feel real—until a blackmail scheme threatens to destroy Liam’s life.
books.title: Fake Dating the Hockey Star

books.description:
On her wedding day, Elara is betrayed by her father, her fiancé, and her illegitimate half-sister, who throw her off a cliff as a sacrifice to the dragons. Refusing to die as an offering, she becomes entangled with three dragon princes—one cold, one rakish, and one fiercely devoted. As they save one another, she falls in love with all three.
Then the Blood Moon Curse strikes: choose one, and the other two must die; save all three, and she must perish. Elara defies the curse by sacrificing her life for the three princes she loves. In return, they tear out their own dragon cores to bring her back, fulfilling a thousand-year-old legend through a love shared by four.
Reborn as the Mother of Dragons, Elara burns her enemies to ashes, ends a millennium of sacrifices, and rules the dragon realm alongside her three lovers.
books.title: Bride of the Three Dragons

books.description: Fed up with Kenny, her cheating husband who never cooks or helps with childcare, Mary drunkenly subscribes to "WeeklyHubby." Each delivery fixes one of his flaws, but the men are perfect at only one thing. Just as she's ready to cancel, Adrian arrives—the flawless final husband. His secret? He's the service's founder, who fell for Mary through her data and shipped himself to her door.
books.title: I Subscribed to a Better Husband

books.description: After a near-fatal car crash, a broke Mexican handyman gains the supernatural ability to see the hidden numbers governing life, and the ability to fix anything. Using his new powers to repair broken fortunes and destroy his enemies, he races to save a doomed heiress before his own ticking countdown exacts a fatal price.
books.title: Handyman Jose Saves the Day

books.description: Destitute and childless, Ivy pulls a golden flounder from the sea—a prince cursed in a past life, who offers three wishes for his freedom. She asks for nothing, yet at last conceives. Enraged, her husband forces her to spend them: she becomes the richest woman alive, then queen, while he gives her eyes and her crown to a maid. He shoves her off the dais; she loses the baby, and wishes him ruined.
books.title: Three Wishes, One Betrayal

books.description: Sakurai Sakura, a beauty creator from modern-day Tokyo, time-slips into the Dayong Dynasty and unexpectedly spends a night with the boy general Xiao Huigen, becoming pregnant. Xiao proposes without hesitation, but the news drags Sakura into a series of schemes: her stepmother secretly tries to make her take abortifacients, and a minister’s daughter spreads rumors that she is a spy. Using modern makeup techniques and girl-group choreography, Sakura sweeps through the noblewomen’s circles and the imperial palace, and even does the Empress’s makeup herself, winning her favor and turning the tables. Xiao, utterly devoted to his wife, tastes her food himself to test for poison and stands firmly at her side, sword drawn at the palace gates. Beneath the fireworks, as her longing for home collides with her true feelings, the two achieve a perfect love that transcends eras and borders.
books.title: My General, I'm from Tokyo!

books.description: Abandoned in a dumpster before Halloween, five-year-old Teddy finds a home with a billionaire widow and her injured daughter. Able to talk to animals and Halloween decorations, uncover hidden treasure and heal the broken, he saves his family's fortune. But when her charming suitor plots to steal her empire and kidnaps Teddy, the little boy must use his magic to protect the family he finally found.
books.title: Mommy, I'm Your Little Monster

books.description: Murdered by her own sister the day she is crowned Great Royal Wife, Tamar is reborn three years earlier at the ceremony that chooses her husband—and Delilah is reborn too, and takes Pharaoh. So Tamar sends her dove to the slaves' quarter and weds a slave in rags, only for him to part the sea. Her husband is the Prophet Moses, and every plague on the kingdom falls after someone hurts her.
books.title: I Chose a Slave, But He Parts the Sea

books.description: Blake spent twenty years posing as a housewife while secretly building Helix, the world's most powerful AI firm, and propping up husband Asher's robotics empire. When Asher cheats and their spoiled twins side with his mistress, Blake reveals her power and destroys everything she built for them. As their lives collapse, Blake claims her legacy, rejects their apologies, and finds love with Adrian.
books.title: The Housewife Strikes Back

books.description: Duke's son Riven is the capital's most notorious failure. In truth, he's the Nebula Knight who wiped out a demon army alone. As a boy, he learned his stepmother had poisoned his mother, so he has played a drunken playboy until he's strong enough for revenge. Then the emperor holds a tournament for Princess Lyra's hand. When even Riven's brother falls to an invader, Riven finally steps up.
books.title: The Outcast Heir, God-Mage of the Galaxy

books.description: Evelyn, a surgeon who gave up her career for her family, discovers while pregnant that her husband Connor is sleeping with his secretary, Vanessa. To shield his mistress, Connor shoves her down and cuts off her medical care, endangering her and the twins. At her lowest, the unborn twins awaken: Devil commands wealth, Angel brings luck. Evelyn divorces him, returns to the OR—and makes them pay.
books.title: Angel & Devil - Mommy, We’ll Save You!

books.description: Football coach Jack Carter ignores his son Ethan’s desperate calls, unaware that star quarterback Mason is brutally tormenting him. When Ethan dies and Jack discovers the truth, his guilt turns to vengeance. Armed with evidence, Jack exposes Mason before the world, destroys his football career, and ensures he pays for taking his son away.
books.title: The Final Play: The Father's Revenge

books.description: Broke law student Noah has always believed he’s an ordinary Beta—until a feral werewolf Alpha corners him in an alley and awakens him as an Omega. The Alpha is Adrian Kane, heir to a wolf dynasty and his 100% pheromone match. As Adrian’s scheming stepbrother closes in, will Noah accept his fate and embrace a future with the man he swore he’d never need?
books.title: UNTOUCHABLE ALPHA

books.description: Annie, an innocent college student, is hired through her boyfriend Bill as assistant to his father Scott, president of Hand Corporation. Controlling and full of hidden desire, Scott tests her limits and draws her into a forbidden affair. At a family dinner, their stolen moment in a hallway raises suspicion, and when Miranda’s diamond earring vanishes she accuses Annie. Bill proposes the cameras.
books.title: Prisoner Of Love

books.description: Betrayed by her husband and humiliated at work, Sienna discovers a devil's notebook that controls human desires. Guided by a seductive demon, she uses its power to take revenge on those who betrayed her. But when she tries to dominate Aiden, a ruthless CEO, their dangerous power game sparks unexpected passion. Is their love real, or just another trap set by the devil?
books.title: S Note: Desire for Control

books.description: Eighteen years after the nuclear war, the surface is contaminated and men have nearly disappeared. Nate lives in a sealed shelter with the three women who raised him: Vamira the vampire, Zena the zombie nurse, and Seraphina the lamia. The “health checks” that begin when he comes of age are not health checks at all. A screen displays his BREEDING SCORE, and the three women agree that whoever reaches 100 percent first will carry his child.
books.title: The Mutant Mating Shelter

books.description: Secretly the strongest archmage, Aiden builds his wife's success despite her scorn—then catches her cheating. Even the baby isn't his. He beats her lover and ends their marriage. They still demand he kneel. Instead, three powerful queens arrive, each declaring him her husband. As they compete for him, he strips his ex of power and crushes anyone who dares insult him or his queens.
books.title: The Hidden Archmage and His Three Queens

books.description: In a world ruled by beastfolk bloodlines, Liam is mocked as a stray who can't transform. After ten years together, his girlfriend Mei betrays him with John, heir to the lion throne. Abandoned and humiliated, Liam unexpectedly bonds with Selena, the beautiful chief of the Snow Leopard Clan. But the ring he's worn since birth bears the symbol of the legendary White Lion King. Who is Liam really?
books.title: The Stray Beast Was the White Lion King

books.description: Callie joins a secret royal surrogacy program for one reason: the money. But she delivers two glowing dragon eggs, panics, and lies to King Adrian's face. Now she's scrubbing palace floors while hiding hatchlings who shapeshift into children — and calling the king "Daddy." Adrian knows more than he admits. Because three years ago, a girl on a cliffside bandaged a wounded black dragon's wing.
books.title: The Dragon King's Secret Heirs

books.description: Brilliant surgeon Ethan is framed for a patient’s murder by his wife Kara and her lover Damian. Locked away, he can only watch as his little daughter Lily is abused. In prison he is taken in by Drake, the legendary “Hell’s Fist King,” who turns his mastery of anatomy into lethal combat skill and leaves him an underground empire. Three years later Ethan walks free—and his reckoning begins.
books.title: Hell's Legacy: Fist of Revenge

books.description: Cast out by her family on a rainy day — and pregnant — she vowed to raise the child alone. Five years later, a billionaire she cannot even remember comes looking for her, with no idea that the child is his own blood.
books.title: The Billionaires Secret Heir

books.description: Warehouse worker Alan learns he is the long-lost son of the world's richest tycoon, then an accident leaves him in a coma. For three years his girlfriend Lena works odd jobs to pay his bills, enduring scorn. Awake at last, he quietly uses the family fortune to punish the adoptive parents who tried to unplug him, funds a charity, reveals he is the heir, and weds the woman who stayed.
books.title: Lovers Apart in Calamity

books.description: Vivian Sterling gave up her name, her family, and her fortune for the man she loved. He repaid her with another woman, another daughter, and a lie ten years deep. When his other family nearly kills her child, she kneels in the street and licks their shoes to save her daughter. Let them laugh. The moment her daughter is safe, this city is going to find out who really owns it.
books.title: The Hidden Queen of Chicago

books.description: At the moment of her death, Ha-eun is sent back nine years. Armed with an hourglass that turns back time and her memories of the future, she begins her revenge on the chaebol family that killed her. As she gains vast wealth and power and overturns her fate, Alex, a chaebol heir hiding his true identity, appears before her — and revenge and romance begin to intertwine.
books.title: The Villainess Turns the Hourglass

books.description: After three years of loyal work, genius LA bike tuner Zack Turner is paid in frozen pork ribs by his greedy uncle Carl. He quits and opens his own shop, where flawless skill and integrity draw clients from a pro racer to a moto blogger. Rival boss Victor hits back with supply cuts, frame-ups and arson while Carl smears him online, but Zack's crew stands firm: craftsmanship and grit win out.
books.title: Not Fixing This Bike

books.description: Anna's quiet, lonely life changes the day she finds a hole in her bedroom wall. On the other side lives Zane—the world's most beloved star, adored as a flawless "saint." But behind that smile is a man nothing like his image: cold, commanding, dangerous. She can't look away, drunk on knowing the real him. Then the strange signs begin—as if the star behind the wall knows he's watching back…
books.title: Through the Wall

books.description: Kwon Jaesin has spent his life as a notorious fixer in the criminal underworld. To buy the island where he and his found family live, he strikes a deal with Chairman Lee — who sets one condition: marry his spoiled granddaughter, Lee Arin. To achieve his goal, Jaesin reinvents himself from shadowy criminal to upstanding, dependable man. True to his word, he rushes into a marriage with Arin — Seoul's most infamous troublemaker — and sets his plan in motion: tame his new wife. Arin despises Jaesin for being charming in public while speaking down to her and pushing her around in private, and desperately tries to break free. But little by little, she finds herself drawn to the dangerously attractive man she married.
books.title: Taming My Young Bride

books.description: Luke, a poor porter humiliated by his wife's family at his father-in-law's birthday, stumbles home drunk and picks up an anonymous ten-million-dollar check dropped by a tycoon fleeing assassins. Keeping quiet, he saves a failing freight station and builds an honest logistics firm. Through his in-laws' extortion, sabotage and murder plots, his wife Megan stands by him as he builds an empire.
books.title: Unexpected Windfall

books.description: Betrayed by her knight, who chooses her sister, Sera escapes her cruel family by agreeing to wed Cassius, a crown prince feared as a monster. As his devotion heals her wounds and her magic calms his torment, they fall in love. But when her former knight learns she was his true savior, his regret turns to obsession, forcing Sera to fight for her chosen love and freedom.
books.title: My Knight Chose My Sister

books.description: Yoon Seojun, secretary to corporate chairman Lee Hyeonwoo, has been secretly in love with him since the moment they first met three years ago — but hides his feelings, convinced the gap between them can never be crossed. Then one day, Seojun is given a terminal diagnosis and decides he can no longer keep his emotions buried. One unexpected night together turns them into secret lovers. But conspiracies surrounding the company, rivals scheming against them, and Seojun's own hidden secret surface one after another — throwing their love into a fierce crisis. Can the two of them weather every trial and hold on to what is real?
books.title: Don't Call Me President in Bed

books.description: Six years after a one-night stand with the mysterious assassin Jake Python leaves Melissa Theron raising their daughter alone, the disgraced heiress reunites with him and discovers that the dangerous stranger she never forgot is secretly the Black Phantom—the world’s deadliest killer and the only man powerful enough to protect their family from her murderous relatives.
books.title: The World's Deadliest Assassin Is My Baby daddy

books.description: Sold to the vampires by her own father, Laila is forced into life as a blood servant. At the auction, Vampire Prince Raven saves her and realizes she is the girl who once saved his life. He vows to protect her, but their love endangers them: Nyx, obsessed with Raven, traps Laila, and Damon will stop at nothing for the throne. When Laila sacrifices herself, Raven turns her into a vampire.
books.title: Blood Oath With My Vampire Lord

books.description: Just after seizing his family empire, mafia heir Leonardo learns his stored sperm sample was mistakenly used on another patient. Rushing to the hospital, he catches a frail young woman as she nearly collapses: Sophia, recovering from her fifth round of IVF. One brief look stirs memories of the youth in which they once saved each other. But Sophia is married, awaiting a child with Marco.
books.title: He Divorced Me, The Mafia Wanted Me

books.description: After catching his fiancée cheating with his half-brother, wealthy heir Jihoo meets Jiwoo, a gifted barista whose mother is trying to sell him off. Jihoo buys the café and hires him, but their constant clashes turn into forbidden attraction. As Jihoo begins questioning his sexuality, his jealous fiancée and half-brother plot to kill Jiwoo.
books.title: My Boss Orders Me Hot

books.description: Hired as a wet nurse at Silvermoon Manor, Alice soothes the eldest lord Leo through a violent fit and wins the devotion of the youngest, Edward. The second brother, Lucas, pulls her into the nursery wardrobe and proposes. Then Leo, seized by another fit, follows the scent of her milk to the room. Through the crack, Alice sees the "madman" who attacked her in the woods. His hand closes on the door.
books.title: The Three Lords Thirsty for Her

books.description: Baek Seo-yoon, heiress to Korea's top golf company, loses her parents to a meticulous plot by her husband Lee Jae-min and her best friend Han Yu-jin, and is thrown in prison on a false murder charge. A year later, freed and acquitted with help from the legal team her parents left behind, she vows revenge and storms Jae-min's party. At the critical moment, Kang Do-yoon — a Wall Street power investor and her former university senior — steps in to save her, and backed by his capital and intelligence network, Seo-yoon announces her return to the company. Despite Jae-min and Yu-jin's relentless sabotage, she uses her brilliant mind to win the support of major shareholders through a casino showdown and seizes back control of the company. On the day of the share transfer, as the two make their last desperate stand, she exposes every piece of evidence of their crimes and has them arrested — reclaiming her throne and, at the same time, finding true love with Do-yoon.
books.title: Prisoner to Billionaire Queen

books.description: Elena, an eighteen-year-old maid is sent to House Fenraven in their daughter's place. Passing as a Grimfang, she has one week to choose which of the Alpha's sons will take her as mate: Lucien, a vampire who's beautiful and unhurried or Fenrir, a werewolf who's all heat and raw muscle. Both want her. Neither knows she isn't the bride they were promised.
books.title: The Maid and the Three Beasts

books.description: Go Yuna earns a spot at Korea International High — an elite school for the top one percent — through an equal opportunity scholarship. Then overnight, her mother's remarriage makes her the new stepsister of Woo Seungho, the undisputed king of the school's highest social tier, the Platinums. Yuna, who has always been looked down on for being poor, and the arrogant, cold Seungho are now family under the same roof — and they keep clashing and getting tangled up in each other's lives. Between two people worlds apart in status and standing, a precarious and dangerous romance begins.
books.title: I Became the Bully Heir’s Stepsister

books.description: Three years wed and still untouched by her husband Lee Won, noble daughter-in-law Kang Dan is given one month to conceive or he takes a new wife. Desperate, she enters Joseon Seulhwapim, a secret circle where noble couples explore their desires, and meets Ju Heon, a free-spirited scholar who sees her as a woman. Then she learns Won has long frequented it himself. At last she chooses her own life.
books.title: The Secret Wife Exchange

books.description: Stephanie has spent her life crushed under the violence and gaslighting of her stepmother Sara — until she discovers that Damian, the man she impulsively spent a night with, is Sara's new husband. Realizing just how much Sara has staked on this marriage, Stephanie decides to seduce Damian as her path to freedom and revenge. But what begins as cold calculation slowly turns into something real, and when Sara senses the shift, her obsession spirals out of control — driving the three of them toward a catastrophic end.
books.title: One Night with My Stepfather

books.description: After losing her father, Blake moves into the home of Jaxson, the powerful owner of the West's most influential ranch. To her, he is more than a guardian—he is her late father's closest friend, the man she has secretly loved for years, and the one person she can never have. By day, she is sweet and innocent. By night, she hides a dangerous secret. When Jaxson uncovers the truth, the line between duty and desire begins to disappear.
books.title: Seducing My Western Daddy

books.description: Once a genius batter and Rookie of the Year, Choi Tae-san's career is destroyed by a shoulder injury and a devastating slump. On the verge of death, he is sent back to his playing days thirteen years ago. Armed with a system that lets him inherit the instincts of legendary batters, Tae-san joins the perennial last-place Red Wolves and sets out to transform the demoralized team. Facing the interference of his old friend Ryu Hae-kang and the buried truth behind his downfall, can Tae-san rise again to become a legend of Korean baseball?
books.title: Reborn as a Baseball Legend

books.description: To avenge her father, Elara marries the vampire mafia don she believes murdered him, hiding a silver blade beneath her pillow. But her blood carries a scent no predator can resist, awakening his darkest hunger. When a werewolf detective sworn to protect her falls for her, Elara is torn between revenge and desire as she uncovers the truth behind her father’s death.
books.title: My Vampire Husband vs Werewolf Boyfriend

books.description: ER nurse Ian saves a gunshot victim with his own rare blood. The man is Kael, a mafia boss hiding a fatal secret: hemophilia. Kael kidnaps Ian from his own wedding and offers a 3 billion won contract as his private nurse. Betrayed by his fiancée and family, Ian signs and moves in; the cold boss's clumsy tenderness makes his heart race. A dangerous contract turns into something real.
books.title: You Can't Escape Me

books.description: For centuries, humans and Fae have been enemies. To prevent another war, human princess Eliana is forced to marry Caspian, the wicked Fairy King. But when her mysterious light magic binds her life to his darkness, their political marriage becomes true love. Together, they uncover a 300-year-old conspiracy and discover their union may be destined to unite two worlds.
books.title: The Human Princess Betrothed to the Wicked Fairy King

books.description: After her divorce, CEO Serena closes her heart to love. Everything changes when she falls for Jax, her handsome 22-year-old assistant. Just as their passion grows, Serena discovers a shocking truth: Jax is her best friend Mia's son. Driven apart by guilt, they risk losing each other forever. But after a tragic racing accident, Serena learns he has loved her for years. Can their forbidden love survive friendship, scandal, and fate?
books.title: Claimed by My Best Friend’s Son: The Forbidden Rules of Temptation

books.description: After a charged encounter in a crowded elevator, an engaged woman discovers the mysterious stranger who left her breathless is her new CEO, and her fiancé’s father. As fate keeps trapping them in increasingly intimate situations, forbidden desire pulls her into a web of corporate secrets, stolen moments, and a dangerous choice between the life she planned and the man she can’t resist.
books.title: Good Vibrations with the Pleasure King

books.description: Claire Hale, a florist who lost her brother to mob violence, wants nothing to do with the mafia. But one rainy night, a wounded stranger crashes into her flower shop—and after Claire saves his life, she discovers he is Roman Moretti, the city’s feared mafia king. She becomes the target of his dangerous obsession—and his determination to make her his despite her fiancé.
books.title: The Mafia King Claimed Me

books.description: When a sex therapist sneaks into a cursed werewolf manor to rescue his kidnapped brother, he's forced to forge a love bond between two rival alphas to break their curse. But when the Alpha’s bond unexpectedly locks onto Angel instead, each therapy session draws them closer, igniting a forbidden romance that could unravel the pack’s natural order.
books.title: Bussy and the Beast (Live-Action)

books.description: Scholarship player Jesse loses the captain's spot to his rival Knox. Digging through Knox's locker, he finds a love letter. Black curls, blue eyes, a stubborn streak. Jesse vows to steal "her" first and crush Knox. But the more suspects he rules out, the stranger it gets. Sharing a room, becoming his injured hand, trading lucky kisses—their feelings start to shift. So who is the letter about?
books.title: My Rival Quarterback's Crush Is Me

books.description: To save her dying mother, Quinn strikes a one-night deal with Wyatt Sterling, heir to a Texas oil dynasty. Three months later, she discovers she's pregnant — with quadruplets. And the father isn't Brett, the ex who abandoned her, but Brett's billionaire uncle Wyatt, her one-night partner. Meanwhile, Wyatt faces losing his vast ranch and oil empire to Brett unless he can prove his worthiness through marriage before turning thirty. Amid conspiracies and betrayals over the right of inheritance, Quinn's four children become the only hope of changing the Sterling family's fate.
books.title: Carrying the Oil Baron`s Four Heirs

books.description: Seung-jae, a prickly perfectionist with three Michelin stars for three years, loses his memory in an accident. Ji-yu, handing out free lunchboxes to the homeless, takes him in; tasting one spoiled bite, he cooks a fine meal from her last scraps, and she hires him. Her ex-husband Ji-hyuk, a one-star chef, torments her with his mistress. Both enter Tavre's head-chef contest, and he plays dirty.
books.title: Lost Chef, Hidden Legend

books.description: After saving Crown Prince Adrian from a shipwreck, mermaid princess Luna watches the scheming Isabella take credit for the rescue. Luna trades her voice for human legs, but the bargain carries a deadly curse. She must expose Isabella’s lies and win Adrian’s true love before she dissolves into sea foam forever.
books.title: The Mermaid Who Stole a Prince's Heart

books.description: Refusing her late designer mother’s legacy, Yulia joins the company as a disguised intern to prove her real worth. But her fellow intern steals her identity and claims the spotlight! As the real Yulia plays the fake and the impostor poses as the real thing, a high-stakes clash begins on the same battleground. Can she reclaim her pride with pure talent? A thrilling revenge drama begins!
books.title: The Villain Wears My Name

books.description: Lee Dae-won scrapes by on overdue bills and instant noodles. An accident drops him into a BL novel, in the body of Ju Yeo-won, a sickly chaebol heir. Sure he'll stay rich forever if he dodges the ending kiss, he avoids lead Kang Han-kyung and uses extra Yoon I-jeong. But the plot goes off-script, and he's given months to live: the only escape is a kiss with the one he loves. What will he choose?
books.title: Help! Trapped in a CRAZY BL Novel

books.description: Dohyeok thought he had everything. Then his grandfather dies suddenly, and his mother is framed as a murderer who poisoned her father-in-law. One forged will brings the family crashing down — the penthouse seized, the bank account back to zero. A third-generation chaebol heir, living his second life, reduced to a penniless wretch overnight. It was all the doing of his uncle, Cha Hyeonseok. But inside Dohyeok's head are the memories of a second life — everything he needs to turn the tables. An unknown boy group he crosses paths with at a cheap rice soup restaurant. An entertainment company everyone laughs at. And a final one billion won bet on borrowed money. The board of revenge, reset in the palm of a ten-year-old. Dohyeok's second revenge begins — and this time, who will be the one to kneel?
books.title: A Genius Baby's Life Turnaround 2

books.description: When Celeste Voss comes to collect her parents' debt, Nora offers herself in her sister's place — collared, kneeling, and owned. She schemes with a childhood friend to bring Celeste down, even as every touch pulls her deeper. But the collar is a leash, the friend is the trafficker, and Celeste is an undercover agent. To free forty women, Nora must risk the one thing she never meant to give.
books.title: I Became the Mafia Queen’s Pet

books.description: Kael is a young man bearing a cursed mark. Written off as cursed his entire life, he scrapes by at the bottom of a knights' training camp. But his mark is not proof of a curse — it is the emblem of a legendary knightly clan erased from the kingdom's history. After his mother's death, the sealed magic within him begins to slowly awaken. Meanwhile, Drake, who rules the kingdom, moves to eliminate Kael before the truth can surface. Kael must now confront the secrets the kingdom has buried, determined to prove his identity as a descendant of the Sword.
books.title: The Lost Boy of a Fallen Kingdom

books.description: Sojin, heiress to a renowned golf resort, meets Junseo — the heir of a rival company, who approaches her hiding his true identity. At first he dismisses her as a spoiled heiress, but as he discovers her passion, sincerity and warm heart toward the resort, he finds himself falling for her. As the two come to see each other's true feelings, a sweet romance begins on the green.
books.title: Love in Thailand

books.description: Between rent and her mom's hospital bills, romance was the last thing on scholarship student Grace's mind. But after a disastrous first encounter, she ends up tutoring Adrian—the rich football star she can't stand. They clash at every turn, but somewhere between the bickering, sparks start to fly. A college romance that was never part of the plan—and turns out to be the best thing in it.
books.title: Charming the Campus Kings

books.description: In a kingdom where your worth is measured by the dragon bonded to your soul at birth, a princess born with none is drowned by her own father, the Dragon King. Sixteen years later, she returns with a terrifying secret: she was never powerless. She is the source of every dragon alive, and with a single command, she can take them all back.
books.title: Mother of Dragon's Burning Revenge

books.description: Ava, a "defective" omega who cannot shift, has spent three years drinking the "medicine" her mate Derek gives her nightly—unaware it is poison sealing her wolf and draining her power into him. Cast out for his scheming mistress, the wounded Ava is rescued by Lucian, the Wolf King, who reveals the truth: she carries the fabled Moon Blood of the lost Moon Queen. As she awakens her silver wolf before the whole pack, three alphas rally to her side—but every use of her power burns her lifespan, and a hidden enemy stirs.
books.title: Rejected by the Moon, Crowned by the Wolf

books.description: Jack lives quietly in a small village with his mother and his old teacher. One day monsters attack, and his mother is killed. Her last words to him are: "Find your father." With nothing else to go on, Jack sets out for Veilspire, the greatest school of magic in the land. But the entrance exam calls him a "Magic Zero." Everyone laughs — and then a power no one has ever seen awakens inside him.
books.title: Ashborn: Academy of the Veil

books.description: Leila is secretly Zeus's granddaughter until Damon brands their unborn child a rapist's bastard to shield Callista. She seals the child in crystal, divorces him, then reveals the crystal bears both Ares's and Zeus's marks. She exposes Callista's scheme and calls down Olympus's judgment on her. Damon's sentence: not death, but eternal regret, forced to watch Leila live happily with Orion, forever.
books.title: Too Late to Regret: My Lost Goddess

books.description: Noah, a former global idol, lands a role in a Hollywood action film as his last chance to rebuild his shattered image. But on set, he runs into Cade, the stunt coordinator, who refuses to go easy on the arrogant Noah and pushes him hard at every turn. As the two clash over everything, a strange tension quietly begins to simmer between them. Meanwhile, it turns out that Jun — an old bandmate — was behind the rumored discord that drove Noah out of the group Signal. Watching Noah grow closer to Cade with growing irritation, Jun soon figures out Cade's true identity and begins to work at unraveling the two men's relationship…
books.title: MATCHPLAY : Love Action

books.description: After her sister is murdered, Wren signs a supernatural marriage contract with Kael, the feared Beast King, for protection. She soon discovers she can read True Names—and that Kael is slowly being consumed by a deadly curse. As hunters close in and buried betrayals surface, Wren must choose whether to risk her own identity and bind herself to Kael forever to save them both.
books.title: The Beast I Married

books.description: Amy, the Brooks family's adopted daughter, becomes a stand-in bride for young congressman Edward in place of Angela, the family's biological daughter, and enters a contract marriage. As the two open their hearts to each other, they confront the truth behind the abuse within the Brooks household, an illegal bone-marrow harvesting case, and the death of Edward's younger sister. After overcoming misunderstandings and a kidnapping, they confirm their true feelings, and once the Brooks couple is punished for their crimes, they begin a new life as a real married couple.
books.title: The substitute Bride

books.description: Park Chang-wook, hiding his identity as the founder of Taesung Bio, has been living as a hotel janitor — until a greedy daughter-in-law and in-laws look down on him and drive him out of his own home. By chance, he saves Oh Ji-a, daughter of Jeongseong Group's CEO, and forms a bond with the CEO Jeong Se-yeon, leading to a contract marriage. Now, before the arrogant businesspeople who mocked him as a "poor old man" and the family who betrayed him, Chang-wook slowly begins to reveal who he truly is.
books.title: Falling for the Janitor Everyone Looked Down On

books.description: "Do you not know me?! Jiknyeo, the Jade Emperor's daughter and the greatest weaver in heaven!" Jiknyeo, the youngest daughter of the Jade Emperor, is betrayed by Gyeonwoo — the man she loved with everything she had — and falls from the heavens to earth. She wakes up in a 2026 historical drama set, inside the body of Ji Eunhyo, a perpetual extra who can never catch a break. Moved by Eunhyo's miserable life of constant mistreatment, Jiknyeo vows to make her a top star no matter what. The problem is that her co-star is Jo Geonwoo — an insufferable, prickly world star who shares the exact same face as that trash ex. Refusing to let anyone ruin his work, Geonwoo keeps Jiknyeo glued to his side — and despite that infuriating familiar face, Jiknyeo's heart keeps racing against her will. She once fell from heaven, deceived by love. Can she shake off love this time around and soar to the top — not of the heavens, but of the human world?
books.title: Fated to Love My Superstar Enemy

books.description: On the ancient continent ruled by dragons, Aslan Valencia – the powerful heir of the Obsidian Dragon Clan and a top candidate for Dragon Lord – falls in love with a human girl named Evelyn. However, Evelyn disappeared five years ago. Five years later, a little dragon cub with golden dragon eyes bursts into the dragon sacred ground and calls Aslan "Dad." Through being depended on by the child and being forced to take care of her, Aslan gradually becomes a qualified father. Meanwhile, the conspiracies hidden within the dragon clan begin to surface.
books.title: The Ruthless Dragon King Is a Girl Dad

books.description: Hotel CEO Vanessa fires maintenance worker Ethan over a safety dispute, only for both to be locked inside a deadly couple's escape room by a hidden enemy. Forced to cooperate through a series of intimate life-or-death challenges, the two—divided by status—must rely on each other to survive. As they brave one peril after another, their prejudices gradually dissolve. The true mastermind turns out to be Vanessa's fiancé Julian, who seeks to seize power and destroy them both. At the brink of death, they refuse to escape alone, instead joining forces to record evidence of his crimes and expose the conspiracy. In the end, they break free from the trap, transcend class boundaries, and find their way to each other.
books.title: Trapped In a Lover’s Game With My CEO

books.description: n 1925 Chicago, Rose sacrifices her future to spare her sister a marriage to Andre Kaminski, leaving the mobster Gio she has loved for years. After Gio chooses her cruel sister Orla, abuses Rose, and causes her miscarriage, Rose finds safety and respect with Andre. Gio learns the truth too late. Rose rejects his final bid to reclaim her; he dies in a police shootout, and she begins a new family.
books.title: The Bootlegger's Regret

books.description: Ella thought she had found true love, only to discover that her fiancé Liam was cheating on her and had never truly loved her. Devastated and humiliated, she agrees to team up with Liam's powerful older brother, Alexander, to destroy the people who betrayed her. As Ella becomes Alexander's secretary and their secret relationship deepens, revenge, jealousy, family power struggles, and hidden secrets threaten to tear them apart.
books.title: Falling for My Fiance's Brother

books.description: Victor, the second son of global food conglomerate Le Grand Group and its youngest-ever Michelin three-star chef, enters a culinary duel against his older brother Eric for the right to inherit the family empire — a tradition passed down through generations. In the midst of it all, he crosses paths with Micah, a man he hasn't seen in eight years, now working at a gay bar. Once accepted into Le Cordon Bleu, Micah had his dreams shattered by a false embezzlement charge against his father and a suicide attempt — and he blames Victor for everything. Victor recognizes Micah's extraordinary palate and brings him onto his team; despite clashing like sworn enemies, the two become perfect partners in the kitchen. As the competition intensifies, Eric's schemes and the truth behind the embezzlement begin to surface, and the two men face their final showdown against the real enemy. They win by choosing the cuisine of a new era over tradition — and Eric is arrested. Victor's final choice is not the group, but Micah. He follows him, stakes his claim to the heirship, and confesses his love.
books.title: Tastes of You

books.description: For eight months, Kang Sung-hoe boss Lee Kanghyun has searched relentlessly for the woman who saved his life. When he finally finds her, she is Yoo Seoyeon — a woman raising a child alone, abandoned even by her own family. But then he notices something: the child's birthday matches the exact night he spent with her. "I'll take responsibility for you and the child." The world's most dangerous man begins to move — to protect the woman he loves and the child who may be his.
books.title: The Dangerous Boss’s Missing Bride

books.description: Desperate to pay for his mother’s surgery, Sam joins RAW, a steamy BL reality show where contestants must push their bedmate’s heart rate to 150 BPM to win $500,000. His plan unravels when Leo, the ex who broke his heart, walks into the villa. As seductive games, jealous rivals, and buried feelings push them together, Sam must decide whether the prize—or a second chance at love—is worth the risk.
books.title: The Bedmate Game: Boys Love

books.description: Miju, an ordinary housewife, begins to feel her heart flutter for Doyoon, a younger photographer she meets by chance, when she discovers that her husband, Taeseok, is having an affair. But an even greater tragedy begins when she loses her son, Jiwoo, while her husband is away with his mistress. Three years later, Miju returns as a successful businesswoman and slowly drives Taeseok and his mistress, Dakyung, toward ruin through a calculated psychological battle, a fake investment scheme, and money as bait. As her revenge nears completion, another long-hidden truth comes to light: Doyoon is revealed to be Taeseok's secret son, sending her revenge in an unexpected direction. At the end of a journey tangled with wounds, love, and betrayal, Miju is faced with her final choice.
books.title: My Husband's Secret Son

books.description: Princess Elia disguises herself as a servant boy to survive, only to become the sole person capable of calming the cursed Crown Prince Adrian. Unaware that his new servant is actually a woman—and his destined soulmate—Adrian refuses to let her leave his side. As forbidden love grows, Elia must choose between protecting her secret and saving the cursed prince.
books.title: The Crown Prince's Virgin Bride
